frontend.title: Frontend development

backend.title: Backend & APIs

fullstack.title: Full-stack products

motion.title: WebGL & motion websites

ecommerce.title: E-commerce
ecommerce.description: Online stores with a fast catalog, checkout and payments, built to sell and easy to manage.

Stack.label: Stack
Stack.title: Tools I build with

Process.label: Process
Process.title: How we'll work together
Process.intro: A clear process with no surprises: you always know what is happening and what comes next.

brief.title: Brief
brief.description: We talk through your goals, audience and constraints. I come back with a clear scope, timeline and estimate.

design.title: Design
design.description: Structure first, then a visual design in Figma that you can click through before any code is written.

build.title: Development
build.description: I build in short iterations with a live preview link, so you see progress every few days and can steer early.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: Testing on real devices, performance and SEO checks, then deployment to your domain with analytics in place.

support.title: Support
support.description: After launch I fix issues, add features and keep dependencies up to date, so the product stays fast and secure.
